contentHtml:
UK health science brand Bio-Synergy has brought its DNA + Epigenetics Kit to Mumbai, marketed and distributed in India by Kynora Life Sciences LLP.

Nearly one in five adults in Mumbai shows signs of metabolic syndrome, a combination of risk factors that can increase the likelihood of diabetes and heart disease.1The DNA + Epigenetics Kit is designed for this important window, when people can still take meaningful steps for their long-term health.

The kit measures epigenetic gene methylation, showing how current lifestyle, diet, and environment alter gene expression and biological age. It analyses over 300 bodily markers and delivers a detailed report with personalised lifestyle suggestions for improvement, along with in-house researched nutraceuticals to support metabolic health. All user DNA data is kept strictly confidential.

Speaking on the DNA+Epigenetics launch in Mumbai, Daniel Herman, Founder, Bio-Synergy UK, shared, “Mumbai moves with an energy like no other, and we’re excited to bring a new perspective on health to this dynamic city. DNA and epigenetics can help people understand their unique biology and make smarter, more personalised choices for a healthier future.”

Dr Katherine Rahill, Ex-NASA Scientist and Chief Scientific Officer, Bio-Synergy UK, said, “At NASA, my work focused on how demanding environments change the human body over time. DNA and epigenetic testing applies the same principle we use with astronauts: measure early, understand how the body is responding, and act before small changes become lasting ones.”

Ritesh Bajaj, Cricket Strength and Conditioning Coach, said, “Cricketers train hard, but most programmes aren’t built on Individual outcomes. Two players can follow the same plan and respond very differently. Seeing how an individual’s body responds to training, recovery and nutrition lets us coach the person in front of us, not a template.”

Dr Ashish Vakil, IVF Specialist, said, “Long before a couple walks into a fertility clinic, lifestyle has already been shaping their health. When people can see how their habits are affecting their biology, they have a real reason to make changes early.”

Routine preventive assessments often rely on periodic clinical evaluations and laboratory tests, which provide a snapshot of selected measures. The company positions DNA and epigenetic testing as a crucial source of personalised health information, enabling people to understand how their lifestyle is shaping their long-term health trajectory and to take informed action, whether the priority is metabolic wellbeing, sustained energy or healthy ageing.
